_about: Research verdicts and checkpoints shown on the dashboard's Research tab. Edit by hand (or ask Claude) when a verdict lands. verdict: GO | NO-GO | WEAK | PENDING | LIVE | INFO.
_live_since_note: FRESH START (Alex, Nov 16 11:22 PM ET: 'I just want a fresh start, call all of the rest of it testing fees'). Real-money totals only count live orders placed after this time; everything before is summed in testing_fees (archived, not deleted).

items: Alex's own trades, open-position marks and rounding
testing_fees.note: About $58 deposited and $33.93 left when the fresh start began, so about -$24 in testing fees. AI and server costs are billed outside Kalshi and are not in these numbers.

_paper_since_note: Paper is a blank slate for testing new strategies (Alex, Nov 7): the dashboard only shows paper orders placed after this time. Move it forward to start a fresh test.

bankroll_start._about: Start point for the dashboard's bankroll growth %. Deposits are not gains: add a deposit to amount. at = when this mode started trading.

mentions.label: Mentions NO fade
mentions.backtest_note: Resting NO 75-90c on 'Will X say Y?' words. The Nov 12 audit found about 0c of edge (+0.9c +-0.9; the old Feb 2025-Oct 2026 replay said +4.2c). Paper Nov 12-19; back on REAL money Nov 19 at 1 contract per word (Alex: 'put it back'). Verdict ~Dec 3.

favorites.label: Big-event favorites
favorites.backtest_note: Resting bids on 85-96c favorites in Elections/Politics/Entertainment events with 1M+ contracts traded. Nov 12 exact replay: +3.2c per fill overall, about +2.0c on the markets the 7-day rule actually reaches (Entertainment ~0). Last 24 hours only since Nov 13; 8 contracts since Nov 17 (doubled).

weather_late.label: Late-day weather
weather_late.backtest_note: From midday on, sell brackets that need a new low (or high) beyond what is already recorded, 1c inside the offer, spread 4c+; also buy the bracket holding the extreme. Lows backtest +5.7c per contract Oct 2025-Aug 2026, +3.7c Sep-Nov 2026; highs and holds are untested 1-contract real tests since Nov 12. Lows 2 contracts since Nov 12. Sizes doubled Nov 17 (lows 4, highs/holds and the 16 newer cities 2).

weather.label: Weather day-before
weather.backtest_note: Maker orders 36h before close; Sep-Nov 2026 +2.3c +-1.2 at best. Back on paper Nov 11: the market's forecast now beats the model.

edge-shadow.label: EDGE calls (silent)
edge-shadow.backtest_note: Forecast-based alerts logged but never sent; needs 50+ settled, a profit and Brier better than market

near-shadow.label: Near-locks (silent)
near-shadow.backtest_note: Late-day calls the model rates 95%+, logged silently

macro_fade.label: Fed/CPI fade
macro_fade.backtest_note: Resting NO at 71-95c on Fed and CPI/PCE longshots. Nov 12 exact replay: +8.7c per fill after maker fees (52 release days), about 8 fills a month. 6 contracts since Nov 17 (doubled).

macro_wide.label: Gas + jobless claims fade
macro_wide.backtest_note: The Fed/CPI fade rule on weekly gas prices and weekly jobless claims. Replay Nov 2025-Nov 2026: +6.6c per fill, about 8 events a month. Real-money test since Nov 12; 2 contracts since Nov 17 (doubled).

favorites_wide.label: Election favorites
favorites_wide.backtest_note: Favorites on markets whose listed close is far out but Kalshi expects the result within 7 days (most election markets). Replay: Elections +6.5c per fill, small sample. Real-money test since Nov 12; 2 contracts since Nov 17 (doubled).

favorites_late.label: Favorites, last 24h (paper)
favorites_late.backtest_note: Paper shadow Nov 13 only, switched off the same day when the live favorites rule moved to the 24-hour window. Was: PAPER shadow since Nov 13: the favorites rule but bidding only in the last 24 hours before close. Replay Jan 2025-Nov 2026 on reachable markets: +4.6c per fill vs +2.0c for the live rule, ~20% fewer fills. Decide at the favorites 500-contract review.

favorites_mid.label: Mid-size Entertainment favorites
favorites_mid.backtest_note: 2-contract real-money test since Nov 19 (own $5 stop): the live favorites rule (85-96c, last 24 h, 2 markets per event) on Entertainment events with 300k-1M contracts traded (live favorites needs 1M+). Replay Jan 2025-Nov 2026 on markets that close on schedule: +4.3c per fill, about 8.5 fills a month, 108 events. Politics/Elections at that size lose, so they are left out.

ai_fade.label: Best-AI fade
ai_fade.backtest_note: The Fed/CPI fade rule on Kalshi's weekly Best AI market (KXLLM1): resting NO at 71-95c. Replay Feb 2025-Nov 2026: about +4.6c per fill on ~98 fills (was +5.1c on 85 before a Nov 20 data fix added 13 Sep-Nov fills: 12 wins and one Google upset, -94c on Oct 5). About 4 fills a month. Real money since Nov 14; 6 contracts since Nov 17 (doubled). Rule unchanged (freeze).

rain_evening.label: Evening rain fade
rain_evening.backtest_note: After 8 PM local with no rain recorded yet, buy NO at the ask in the 75-95c band and hold. Replay Jul-Nov 2026: +6.1c per contract after fees, 109 trades. About 1 a day. Real-money test since Nov 13; 2 contracts since Nov 17 (doubled).

spx_range.label: S&P range fade
spx_range.backtest_note: Sell S&P 500 daily-close ranges overnight on the 6 likeliest ranges, cancelled at 8:45 AM ET. Since Nov 20 it sells YES at 25c (NO bid 75c; was 35c / 65c with 0 fills on the first 56 orders). Replay at 25c: +5.1c per fill Feb 2025-Nov 2026, +2.0c +-4.2 on 59 fills Sep 16-Nov 19 (~27 fills a month). The old 35c price replayed +12.8c but rarely filled. Thin edge: judged at the 100-contract review; never below 20c. Real money, 2 contracts since Nov 17.

ndx_range.label: Nasdaq range fade
ndx_range.backtest_note: Sell Nasdaq-100 daily-close ranges overnight on the 6 likeliest ranges, cancelled at 8:45 AM ET. Since Nov 20 it sells YES at 30c (NO bid 70c; was 35c / 65c with 0 fills on the first 30 orders). Replay at 30c: +16.3c per fill Jan 2025-Sep 2026, +18.5c +-7.3 on 19 fills Sep 16-Nov 19 (~9 fills a month). The old 35c price replayed +22.4c but rarely filled. Real money, 2 contracts since Nov 17, own $5 stop.

quake_no.label: Earthquake NO test
quake_no.backtest_note: Daily 'biggest earthquake' markets: during the UTC day, with no quake near the strike yet, buy NO on the 6.6 and 7.0 strikes when USGS 2015-2024 history says NO is worth 5c+ more than its price after the taker fee (usually 86-93c). Replay Sep-Nov 2026: +6.6c +-5.9 on 38 trades over 25 days, but found by slicing after the fact; the pre-registered broad test lost -2.9c. 2-contract real test from Nov 20 with a hard $4 cap (settled losses + open bets). Reviews at 20 and 50 fills.

quake_no_paper.label: Earthquake NO (paper twin)
quake_no_paper.backtest_note: Same rule as the real earthquake test, logged on paper with no cap so the 20/50-fill reviews have data even if the real test stops.

fade_leads.label: Jobs/GDP/Starship fade
fade_leads.backtest_note: The Fed/CPI fade rule (resting NO 71-95c, 2 h-21 days out) on KXU3 unemployment, KXGDP and KXSPACEXSTARSHIP. Replay Dec 2024-Nov 2026 +13.0c on 126 fills, 39/39 releases up, zero losing fills; walk-forward +12.6c on 68 fills. Fair long-run ~+7 to +12c: the real risk is one surprise release. REAL money 2 contracts from Nov 20 (Alex: 'this is test money'), hard $6 cap incl. open bets, one push when hit. Reviews at 10 and 30 settled fills.

fade_leads_paper.label: Jobs/GDP/Starship fade (paper)
fade_leads_paper.backtest_note: The Fed/CPI fade rule (resting NO 71-95c, 2 h-21 days out) on KXU3 unemployment, KXGDP and KXSPACEXSTARSHIP. Replay Dec 2024-Nov 2026 +13.0c on 126 fills, 39/39 releases up, zero losing fills; walk-forward (picked before Sep 2025) +12.6c on 68 fills after, other ~40 series -2.9c. Fair long-run figure ~+7 to +12c (one surprise release would cost 2-3 fills). ~5 fills/month. Paper twin (1 ct, no cap) of the real 2-ct test from Nov 20; reviews at 10 and 30 settled fills.

ship_paper.label: Shipping counts (paper)
ship_paper.backtest_note: Weekly ship-transit counts (Hormuz, Suez, Panama, Bab el-Mandeb) vs an IMF PortWatch forecast (14-day average x 7, negative binomial): buy the side worth 5c+ more than its price after the taker fee, until the week ends. Replay Sep-Nov 2026 +4.7c +-8.3 on 216 trades (+7.0c +-7.5 on 243 with the full candle window): not significant. PAPER ONLY from Nov 20. First look at 20 settled fills (Tue Nov 24, when the first week settles), verdict at 100 (~Dec 15).

events.title: Bot goes live: LOCK alerts + $37 test bankroll
events.summary: Scanner watches every Kalshi daily high/low market and pushes LOCK alerts when readings already decide a bracket.

events.title: Liquidity rewards
events.summary: Not worth it at our size, and the program ends Jan 1, 2027.

events.title: Bracket arb, gas, Polymarket arb, long-dated climate
events.summary: No usable edge in any of the four after fees.

events.title: Hourly temperature markets
events.summary: Market is well calibrated. Weak lead: fading 12-25c longshots 30-55 min out (+3c/contract, probably noise).

events.title: LOCK speed race
events.summary: About 30+ locked brackets per day, all already at $1.00 when first seen. Looks like a race we lose.

events.title: Monthly rain thresholds (census)
events.summary: Silent census every 15 min. Early: every passed threshold was already at $1.00.

events.title: Weather model backtest (full year)
events.summary: Day-before edge was profitable Jan-Aug 2026, about break-even Sep-Oct as the market caught up. Paper maker orders running.

events.title: NBM / MOS forecast inputs
events.summary: Better forecasts (NBM best single source) but no extra trading edge. The market already prices it.

events.title: Market-making bot on hourly temps
events.summary: Month replay about break-even; small plus in Miami/NYC, Chicago loses. Paper replay Nov 5-12.

events.title: Mentions longshot fade
events.summary: +4.2c per filled contract over 21 months (18 of 21 up). Running automatically on paper from Nov 5.

events.title: Economic data releases (CPI, PCE, GDP)
events.summary: Kalshi beats or matches the nowcasts; no lag edge. Three weak leads to re-test.

events.title: Longshot fade in Financials / Econ / Crypto
events.summary: One month showed +4.5c (Econ) and +6.8c (Financials). Full-history check running.

events.title: Longshots and favorites in every other category
events.summary: Only favorites at 85-96c in BIG events (1M+ contracts) pay, +3.7c per filled contract; small events lose. Running automatically on paper from Nov 5.

events.title: Newly launched markets
events.summary: Launch backtest running; new-market watcher logging in shadow.

events.title: Sportsbook odds vs Kalshi
events.summary: Research just started.

events.title: Weather day-before back to paper
events.summary: Kalshi's prices now forecast tomorrow's temperature better than our models do (1.31F miss vs 1.60F), so the edge is gone. Real test lost $3.95 on 43 contracts. Re-check Jan-Feb.

events.title: Late-day lows
events.summary: After midday the market overpays for brackets below the low already recorded. Selling them backtests at +5.7c per contract (Oct 2025-Aug 2026) and +3.7c (Sep-Nov 2026), about 7 fills a day. Real money at 1 contract since Nov 11 (Alex's OK); reviews at 100/300/500 contracts.

events.title: 15-minute bot all paper
events.summary: Rule E2 went 0-4 on real money (-$3.22). Alex: no proven edge, so the whole 15-min bot is paper; it goes back to real money only with his explicit OK.

events.title: Mentions NO fade to paper
events.summary: Main-bot audit found no edge in Mentions after fees; it keeps running on paper (AI shadow judged ~Dec 3).

events.title: Gas + jobless claims fade and election favorites
events.summary: macro_wide (weekly gas + jobless claims fade, replay +6.6c) and favorites_wide (election favorites by expected decision date) start on real money at 1 contract.

events.title: Evening rain fade
events.summary: After 8 PM local with no rain recorded, buy NO at 75-95c and hold. Replay +6.1c per contract; real money at 1 contract.

events.title: S&P range fade
events.summary: Sell S&P 500 daily-close ranges priced 30c+ overnight (NO bids at 65c, cancelled 8:45 AM ET). Replay +12.8c per fill; real money at 1 contract.

events.title: Best-AI fade at 3 contracts
events.summary: The Fed/CPI fade rule on Kalshi's weekly Best AI market (KXLLM1), replay +5.1c per fill, real money at 3 contracts.

events.title: Nasdaq range fade
events.summary: The S&P range rule on Nasdaq-100 ranges (replay +22c per fill), real money at 1 contract with a $5 stop. First orders Nov 15 ~4:05 PM ET.

events.title: Rewards test ended
events.summary: Five-day real-money test of Kalshi's liquidity rewards: $0 earned, $0 lost. Stopped for good; a last check for a late payout on Nov 22.

events.title: Copycat two stages
events.summary: Trial bar (20 counted copies, 15 events, score 77.5+, 4 slots) or full bar (50, 30, 80+). Once on real money only real P&L decides: back to paper when losses use up a $1-5 budget. Rails unchanged: $5 per trader, $8 halt, $10 cash floor.

events.title: Foreman and boss changes
events.summary: The Foreman calls the AI only when a rule flags (all AI under $1/day). New daily live-vs-replay drift check per strategy. The Copycat boss is a shadow judge with no power until it beats a plain rule over 200+ copies (scored ~Dec 1).

events.title: $500 swing ended, fresh start
events.summary: The $500-by-Friday swing ran 3 bets (-$27.64) and was switched off. Alex: 'fresh start, call it testing fees'. Dashboard totals count from Nov 16 11:30 PM ET.

events.title: Every live strategy doubled
events.summary: Alex's checkpoint card: double every live strategy's contracts (favorites 8, Fed/CPI fade 6, Best-AI fade 6, late-day lows 4, the 1-contract tests 2). Scale-up kit stays off.

events.title: Mentions NO back on real money
events.summary: Alex: 'put it back'. 1 contract per word. The audit found about 0c of edge, so it is judged at the Dec 3 verdict.

events.title: Mid-size Entertainment favorites
events.summary: The live favorites rule on Entertainment events with 300k-1M contracts traded. Replay +4.3c per fill, ~8.5 fills a month. 2-contract real test with its own $5 stop.

events.title: Fade round 2 (politics, elections, long-dated)
events.summary: Politics -6.6c, elections -1.0c, long-dated Fed/macro no edge. Two Fed ideas kept for the fade's 500-contract review only.

events.title: Untested-edges hunt
events.summary: S&P above-vs-range (-10.2c), Truth Social post counts (-4.9c) and the daily biggest quake (-2.9c) all fail their pre-registered tests. One weak quake lead (see next).

events.title: Earthquake NO test
events.summary: Alex: 'we should do the earthquake one'. NO on the 6.6/7.0 'biggest quake' strikes late in quiet UTC days. Weak, sliced lead (+6.6c on 38 trades). 2 contracts real, hard $4 cap; paper twin logs the same rule. Reviews at 20 and 50 fills.

events.title: S&P and Nasdaq range sell price lowered
events.summary: 0 fills on the first 56 orders at 35c. Alex: 'drop prices a bit to try and get some fills'. S&P now sells YES at 25c (replay +2 to +5c, thin), Nasdaq at 30c (replay +16 to +18c). Same 2 contracts, caps and stops. Judged at the 100-contract review.

events.title: New-listing radar + edge-fade watch
events.summary: Twice an hour: every new Kalshi listing gets 3 known rules as 1-contract paper bets for 14 days (first: daily gold, silver, copper, Brent, TTF gas, diesel). Push when one clears +3c over 10 fills; real money only with Alex's OK. Every real strategy now has a pre-written kill rule. Farm series (corn, wheat, cattle...) watched; not listed yet.

events.title: Shipping counts paper test
events.summary: Weekly ship-transit counts (Hormuz, Suez, Panama, Bab el-Mandeb) vs an IMF PortWatch forecast. Replay +4.7c +-8.3, not significant. 1 contract on paper; first look Nov 24, verdict at 100 settled fills (~Dec 15).

events.title: Jobs/GDP/Starship fade on real money
events.summary: The Fed/CPI fade rule on unemployment, GDP and Starship markets: +13.0c on 126 replay fills, zero losing fills, walk-forward +12.6c. Alex: 'run em live again, this is test money'. 2 contracts, hard $6 cap incl. open bets, paper twin at 1 contract. Reviews at 10 and 30 fills.

events.title: Best-AI fade replay re-checked
events.summary: A price-data bug hid Sep 14-Nov 9 from the old replay. With it fixed the rule would have filled 13 more times (12 wins, one -94c upset), so the replay drops from +5.1c to about +4.6c. Still positive; no rule change. Live logging was not affected.
